output.sql:
SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin_eur
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 3
output.explanation: Gross margin per product is the line net amount minus cost of goods sold, summed over revenue orders (is_revenue) dated in 2025. The query returns the top three products and assumes amounts are stored in EUR. If margins tie, the lower product ID comes first.
